notes.title: Patch 1.07 Details
notes.content:
[b]Patch 1.07 brings the following:[/b]

Added Option to run in windowed mode.
Adjusted UI in main menu so users with 5120x1440 can now use it.
Fixed a bug where a certain secret boss was not opening their gate once defeated.
Thanks for all the feedback!

notes.title: Patch 1.06 Details
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44274479/50a71a79e73e7c91609a959dc0ce41d4c44b6c30.png[/img]Update patch to Scrap Warden (Version 1.06):
Adjusted the overall file sizes of elements within the game. (performance should see a major boost)
Added language option for Brazilian Portuguese (find in main menu settings). Not available for the steam achievements, yet.
Fixed bug that was inadvertently set audio levels too low to hear when playing for the first time. (technical: player preferences were being set with a low value until settings were used for the first time)
Fixed bug that was setting foreground opacity to max when playing for the first time. (technical: initial opacity setting for graphical foreground is reduced from 1 to 0.4)
Various minor changes and fixes. Thanks for all the support and feedback!

notes.title: Patch 1.05 Details
notes.content:
Update patch to Scrap Warden (Version 1.05):
Added controller and keyboard support to main menu buttons throughout game.
Adjusted tutorial to greatly reduce its difficulty. Thanks for all the support and feedback!

notes.title: Patch 1.04 Details
notes.content:
[b]Minor patch to Scrap Warden (Version 1.03):[/b]
Added option to main menu for adjusting how foreground objects are displayed (technical: settings adjust foreground opacity so user can adjust the intensity of objects in level areas) Thanks for all the support and feedback!

notes.title: Patch 1.03 Details
notes.content:
Patch to Scrap Warden (Version 1.03):
Added "Sound Options" to the game's main menu. Users can now adjust the volume for music and sound effects (technical: settings saved to and loaded from player preferences). Thanks for all the support and feedback!

notes.title: Patch 1.03 Details
notes.content:
[b]Minor patch to Scrap Warden (Version 1.03):[/b]
Added option to main menu for adjusting music and sound volumes (technical: saves to and loads from player preferences) Thanks for all the support and feedback!

notes.title: Patch 1.02 Details
notes.content:
Hello, minor patch to Scrap Warden (Version 1.02):
Adjusted player's ship movement for a smoother feel (technical: angle normalization). Thanks for all the support and feedback!
